text: もうすこしで　つかまえられたのに！

structure.en: I could have caught it, but...!

patterns.name: 〜のに
patterns.explanation: のに at the end of a sentence shows you are sorry it did not turn out that way. つかまえられたのに = 'and I could have caught it!'

patterns.name: 〜られる (potential)
patterns.explanation: られる on a verb here means 'can do'; in the past it is 'could do'. つかまえられた = 'could have caught'.

patterns.name: もう少しで〜
patterns.explanation: もうすこしで says something nearly happened. もうすこしで　つかまえられた = 'I almost caught it'.
